evidence.detail: HEAD resolves to the launcher-supplied target SHA, and git status reported no working-tree changes.
The base and target objects resolve exactly to the launcher-supplied SHAs.
The base-to-target diff changes eight allowed files: the CI workflow, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and ISSUE-0014 governance records. No product source or dependency manifest changed.
The workflow SHA-pins actions/setup-node, selects Node 22, uses frontend/package-lock.json for caching, and runs npm ci, npm run build, and npm test from frontend/ after the existing Python checks.
README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md now state that CI executes the frontend build and tests.
The active-gate rows consistently identify ISSUE-0014 as repair round 2, cite both prior blocked reviews, and direct the next actor to launch this exact review.
Governance validation could not complete because the read-only environment has no writable temporary directory; tempfile.TemporaryDirectory raised FileNotFoundError.

The backend suite discovered and ran 188 tests but ended with 76 errors because sandbox policy prohibits loopback socket binding; the affected tests raised PermissionError from ThreadingHTTPServer.bind().
frontend/node_modules is absent, Vitest is unavailable, and the read-only network-restricted environment cannot run npm ci or generate build artifacts.

limitations: The mandatory governance check could not complete because no writable temporary directory is available.
The backend suite could not pass because sandbox policy blocks its loopback socket tests; 76 of 188 tests errored for that environmental reason.
The frontend build, positive test run, and negative-test proof could not be independently reproduced because dependencies are absent and the environment is read-only and network-restricted.
The recorded positive and negative frontend results in project/issues/ISSUE-0014.md are summarized command evidence rather than raw command transcripts independently reproducible in this checkout.

No local or hosted GitHub Actions runner evidence verifies workflow parsing, action resolution, Node setup, npm caching, timeout sufficiency, or step-level failure propagation. DECISION-029 explicitly accepts the narrower negative-proof residual.
The SHA-pinned actions/setup-node identity and its v7.0.0 annotation could not be independently verified without network access.

ROADMAP.md, project/milestones/M3.md, and docs/security-boundaries.md retain pre-delivery statements that frontend CI has not landed. Prior review records identify these as intentionally deferred documentation residuals outside the issue's allowed CI-status documentation paths.
review.summary: BLOCKED solely because mandatory execution evidence could not be independently completed in the read-only, network-restricted review environment. The inspected workflow and documentation changes are scoped, structurally satisfy the principal acceptance criteria, and the round-2 CURRENT.md repair resolves the prior review's stale active-gate rows. No new correctness or security defect was identified.
